title: Sweep model depth (DEPTH=8 -> 10)
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 10 (model_dim goes 512->640, 4->5 heads); everything else unchanged, dmodel_lr_scale auto-adjusts AdamW LRs.
reflection: val_bpb improved from 1.014027 to 1.002712 (-1.1%), confirming depth was an underexplored, high-leverage lever at this fixed 5-min time budget. Worth a small follow-up grid (e.g. DEPTH=9, 11, 12) to find the local optimum before moving to other axes, since going deeper costs step time (fewer total steps) but seems to pay off in per-step sample efficiency here.
